8252483.en: The cultivator's face contorts with grief and rage as he fixes you with an unwavering glare. After a long moment, he suddenly breaks into uncontrollable sobs. He draws out several talismans and rides the wind away into the distance...
8252483.ch: 面前修士脸上透出既难过又扭曲的神情，他死死的盯着你，过了半晌突然间嚎啕大哭扬起几张灵符，御风而去……

8252484.en: As you walk along the path, a violent gust suddenly whips up before you, sending dust and sand swirling through the air. Through the blinding storm, a cultivator emerges in flight, lunging toward you with deadly intent.
8252484.ch: 你行于路中，前方突然疾风暴卷，尘土飞扬，砂砾迷眼处，一名修士飞身而出，朝你袭来。

8252486.en: Kill! Go ahead and kill me! I'll haunt you forever, even as a ghost!
8252486.ch: 杀！你杀！我做鬼也不会放过你的！

8252487.en: You slew Six-Eyed Bright Pupil... Never again shall you know a moment's peace in this life!
8252487.ch: 你击杀六目明瞳，此生你别想有得一日安宁！

8252488.en: Exactly! You know nothing. You understand nothing at all!
8252488.ch: 对！你根本不知道，不了解！

8252489.en: You fulfilled Xiang Laichi's wish, bringing everything to an end.
8252489.ch: 你遂了向来痴的愿望，把这一切都结束了。

8252490.en: I swear you won't have a single peaceful day for the rest of your life!
8252490.ch: 我不会让你今后有一天安宁日子的！

8252492.en: Ugh... Between you and me, one must fall. Only then will this matter be settled!
8252492.ch: 呃……你我之间，必须有一个倒下，这事才算了结！

8252494.en: Let me go? I'll hound you relentlessly until I take your life.
8252494.ch: 放我？我会一直缠着你，直到将你击杀。

8252495.en: Upon your return to the Silken Cottage, you hear the sound of a quarrel coming from within.
8252495.ch: 你再次来到丝萝小筑时，却听得里面传来争吵之声。

8252496.en: I have no interest in this. You may leave now.
8252496.ch: 我没有兴趣，你可以走了。

8252497.en: You're still obsessed with the ley lines?

8252499.en: I possess countless ancient tomes and even the great secrets of the world.
8252499.ch: 我那边拥有无数藏书，也有八荒的大秘密啊。

8252500.en: I apologize, but I'm not interested. I have no interest in the secrets you've discovered either.
8252500.ch: 抱歉，我没有兴趣。我对你发现的秘密也没有兴趣。

8252501.en: It's because of that person, isn't it?! You're worried about the person! The one you've been watching all this time!
8252501.ch: 是那个人，对不对？你是顾忌那个人！一路上你都关注着的那个人！

8252502.en: I have no desire to converse with someone who has lost their reason. Please leave, I need to rest.
8252502.ch: 我不喜欢和失去理智的说话。你走吧，我要休息了。

8252503.en: As Xiang Laichi rides away on the wind, he comes face to face with you. His features twist with hatred, his eyes burning with accumulated malice. With a contemptuous snort, he finally departs on the rushing wind.
8252503.ch: 向来痴驾驭疾风离开，与你正好照面，他看你的面容变得有点扭曲，目光更是积聚怨毒。他哼了一声，终于驾驭疾风而去。

8252504.en: She stands with her arms crossed, staring blankly at the crystal floating in mid-air. Disappointment fills her eyes, and after a very long moment, she finally lets out a soft sigh.
8252504.ch: 只见{name|B}双手交缠抱胸呆望半空中的地脉结晶。她眼神中透着失望，良久良久终于微微叹息一声。

8252506.en: Dedicating oneself to exploring the ley lines, only to find it all amounts to nothing... Is it not natural to feel such profound loss?
8252506.ch: 用心探索地脉信息，到头来却只是一场空。这时怅然若失，岂非人之常情？

8252507.en: I wasn't even arguing with him, was I? He was just getting worked up on his own. Our fellow cultivator, Mister Xiang, has been constantly inviting me to his residence, but I have absolutely no interest in going.
8252507.ch: 我根本没和他吵起来吧？是他自个在那激动。那位向道友，一直很希望我去到他家中作客，可我完全提不起兴致。

8252508.en: I used to be able to run away, so I came to Chi You and made my home within the ley lines. I thought even with his mighty powers he wouldn't be able to find me here, but to my surprise, he still tracked me down.
8252508.ch: 之前我还能跑，到赤幽州中来，我住进地脉之中，心想他就是再神通广大也找不到了，却没想到还是找来了。

8252509.en: I must thank you for that. When you severed the Nether Air and set up the Celestial Abode Formation around here, he discovered the location of my sanctuary.
8252509.ch: 这就要多谢你了。当时你截断冥气，在这周围结下天宫寰宇阵，他便由此知道我的洞府所在了。

8252510.en: Are you worried I'll go back to gathering information about the ley lines? I won't.
8252510.ch: 你是担心我又去继续收集地脉信息？不会了。

8252511.en: With a wave of her hand, she sends spider silk streaming toward the purple crystal floating in the air, completely enveloping it in mere moments.
8252511.ch: {name|B}一挥手，手中蛛丝向空中地脉紫缠去，只片刻就将之严严实实的包裹起来了。

8252512.en: In the past, I might not have been able to do it, but I've discovered something else quite intriguing. I've decided to set aside these ley line mysteries for now.
8252512.ch: 若在从前，也许不能，但我发现了另一样颇堪玩味的东西，决定先把这地脉之秘放一放。

8252513.en: Hmph, when we crossed paths in combat, I ensnared you with my spider silk and found your thoughts quite fascinating. Now I'm rather curious to see what dark secrets you're hiding in your heart.
8252513.ch: 哼，当时你我交手，我用吐丝缠住了你，发现你的心思挺有意思的。因此我现在倒想看看你心中有什么见不得人的秘密。

8252514.en: She gently reaches out and takes your hand, then kneels beside you, placing your hand on her thigh. With a sweet smile, she ties a slender thread around your wrist.
8252514.ch: {name|B}轻轻一探握住了你的手，她半蹲下来，将你的手放在她大腿上，她则笑眯眯的用一根细长的丝线在你手腕处打了个结。

8252515.en: I'm binding this mark upon you so you don't get yourself killed while adventuring around Chi You. It would be rather inconvenient for me if you died.
8252515.ch: 给你绑个结打个印记，免得你在赤幽州四处冒险，不小心就死掉了，妨碍了我。

8252516.en: She chuckles and rises to her feet, glancing at the purple crystal with a self-mocking smile before turning her gaze upon you. Her pupils dilate and contract as she appears lost in thought before finally breaking into a subtle smile.
8252516.ch: {name|B}笑了笑，重新站起来，她看了看那紫晶，自嘲似的笑笑，然后目光落在你身上。她瞳孔时大时小，似乎正思考着什么，最后微微一笑。

8252517.en: This usually dignified and stern woman suddenly breaks into a smile, and it's as if gentle sunlight suddenly fills the dark ley lines, warming both body and soul.
8252517.ch: 一向雍容严肃的她突然展颜微笑，这幽暗的地脉之中仿佛突然间充满了和煦的阳光，叫人身心俱暖。

8252518.en: As you walk along, you sense something amiss. Your mind grows hazy, and then the silk thread on your wrist suddenly snaps with a buzz. The sharp pain jolts you awake, and you find yourself in a grand mansion.
8252518.ch: 你在路上行走，但觉身边有丝异样。头脑微微一迷，同时手腕丝线嗡的一下突然崩断，剧痛让你立即醒转，然而你发现已身在一处大宅之中。

8252520.en: You see a vast estate with a tall pavilion rising in the distance, its surroundings wrapped in countless strands of silk.
8252520.ch: 面前是一所极具规模的庄子，远处一栋小楼高高屹立，可见周边缠有无数丝线。

8252521.en: You reach the back of the mansion and follow a shadowy path, where various demonic beasts stand motionless. Though completely lifeless, their faces display expressions of rage or joy, rendered so vividly that it's impossible to tell if they're real or artificial.
8252521.ch: 你来到宅子后方，沿幽径而去，路上站立各种妖兽，这些妖兽一动不动的毫无生机，但面相或怒或喜欢，却又栩栩如生，叫人难辨真假。

8252522.en: The main building houses countless volumes, each documenting the appearances and behaviors of various demonic creatures. It seems every book here is a record of the mighty beings in the world.
8252522.ch: 主楼中藏书无数，书中记录各种妖兽外貌情态，似乎这里面的书都是对八荒妖物的记录。

8252523.en: You open a thin volume to find doodles at the beginning, followed by written accounts. However, most of the text has been crossed out, leaving only a few readable entries.
8252523.ch: 你翻开薄册，里面除去最开始的涂鸦，后面均为文字记述，而且大量文字已被涂花，仅余数篇可以查看。

8252524.en: We of the Xiang clan, even after fortune allows us to leave Chi You, must always remember our ancestral teachings.
8252524.ch:
我向氏一族，获得机缘离开赤幽州后，仍需谨记祖先遗训。
我向氏一族，获得机缘离开赤幽州后，仍需谨记祖先遗训。
妖兽品类繁杂，后世子孙仍需要世代恭行。谨记谨记。

8252525.en: We must illustrate all demonic creatures in the world, recording their weaknesses in detail, so that cultivators everywhere may better combat these beasts.
8252525.ch: 务以图画天下妖物为任，将之弱点详细记录，以方便天下修士对抗妖兽。

8252526.en: The varieties of demonic beasts are vast and numerous. Our descendants must continue this sacred duty for generations to come. Remember this well.
8252526.ch: 妖兽品类繁杂，后世子孙仍需要世代恭行。谨记谨记。

8252527.en: The illustrations of my ancestors are truly crude. How could even the most skilled artistry perfectly capture the various states of demonic beasts? Such ignorance!
8252527.ch:
先辈们的图画真难看，再精巧的手艺，又怎能完美呈现妖兽的各种情态？
真是愚昧。近日我将一只竹妖擒到内室，用刀子将它节节切断，起出了里面的各种东西。
那些脏器奇形怪状，和我们完全不一样。
一只竹妖已经如此叫人眼界大开，不敢想象其他妖兽又是怎么样的！
对了，我要去将它们抓回来就好了，一只只将它们剖开，仔细看，看明白了！

8252528.en: Recently, I captured a Bambuki and brought it to my inner chamber. I cut it apart segment by segment with a blade, extracting everything from within.
8252528.ch: 近日我将一只竹妖擒到内室，用刀子将它节节切断，起出了里面的各种东西。

8252529.en: Its organs were bizarrely shaped, completely different from our own. If a single Bambuki could prove so enlightening, I can hardly imagine what other beasts might reveal!
8252529.ch: 那些脏器奇形怪状，和我们完全不一样。一只竹妖已经如此叫人眼界大开，不敢想象其他妖兽又是怎么样的！

8252530.en: Yes, I just need to capture them all and bring them back. I'll cut them open one by one, and examine them carefully until I understand everything!
8252530.ch: 对了，我要去将它们抓回来就好了，一只只将它们剖开，仔细看，看明白了！

8252531.en: My accomplishments have already surpassed all my ancestors!
8252531.ch:
我的成就已经超过了我所有先辈了！
庄子里已经有三百多只妖兽的塑象，它们平时一个个站在宅子里面，安安静静的，就像我最忠实的仆人！
家族祖先曾记载赤幽州有六目明瞳与九婴之妖，十分特别！
我得设法去赤幽州抓捕这两只妖兽！
我要将它们放在塌前。如此一来，我就能日日夜夜的看着它们了！

8252532.en: The estate now houses over three hundred preserved beasts, each standing silently, as still as statues—like my most faithful servants!
8252532.ch: 庄子里已经有三百多只妖兽的塑象，它们平时一个个站在宅子里面，安安静静的，就像我最忠实的仆人！

8252533.en: Our ancestral records mention two extraordinary demons in Chi You: the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil and Jiuying!
8252533.ch: 家族祖先曾记载赤幽州有六目明瞳与九婴之妖，十分特别！

8252534.en: I must find a way to go to Chi You and capture these two demons!
8252534.ch: 我得设法去赤幽州抓捕这两只妖兽！

8252535.en: I'll place them before my bed. Then I can gaze upon them day and night!
8252535.ch: 我要将它们放在塌前。如此一来，我就能日日夜夜的看着它们了！

8252536.en: I've found traces of the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil.
8252536.ch:
我发现六目明瞳的形迹了。
她是怎么从赤幽州来到永宁州的？
不过这不重要了。她化身为人以后真的很好看……
不行，我不可以把她做成塑象。
我要她陪伴在我身边，每天伺候我！
到时，我们就是一对神仙眷侣了！

8252537.en: How did she travel from Chi You to Yong Ning? No matter, that's not important anymore.
8252537.ch: 她是怎么从赤幽州来到永宁州的？不过这不重要了。

8252538.en: She's truly beautiful in her human form...
8252538.ch: 她化身为人以后真的很好看……

8252539.en: No, I cannot preserve her like the others.
8252539.ch: 不行，我不可以把她做成塑象。

8252540.en: I want her by my side, serving me every day!
8252540.ch: 我要她陪伴在我身边，每天伺候我！

8252541.en: Then we shall be a divine couple, together for eternity!
8252541.ch: 到时，我们就是一对神仙眷侣了！

8252542.en: As you enter the room, a putrid stench assaults your nose, making you retch. Inside stands a large platform, its surface marked with several large brown stains like splashed ink. The corners are lined with an overwhelming array of blades—straight edges, barbed hooks, and countless other implements.
8252542.ch: 你才走进房屋，一股腥臭之气冲鼻而入，叫人作呕。只见内屋置一大台，上面泼墨似的有着好几大块褐色痕迹。角落则放置各式刀具，或为直刃，或为倒钩，林林种种，目不暇给。

8252543.en: You enter the tower to find its inner floors removed, the vast interior space completely draped in spider silk. Clusters and wisps of webbing hang everywhere—upon closer inspection, it resembles her silken cottage...
8252543.ch: 你进入高塔之中，只见里面隔层已被移除，广大的内部空间里满布蜘蛛吐丝，左一簇，右一团，细看之下，仿佛来到{name|B}的丝萝小筑之中……

8252544.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil, I love you! I will invite you here to live with me, and we shall spend our days together like immortals... Huh! Who's there?
8252544.ch: 六目明瞳，我喜欢你！我要把你请到这里来，与我双宿双栖，以后我们就过神仙一般的日子……咦！谁？

8252545.en: I can't believe you've awakened so quickly—impossible, how could this be! Curse it! What's that in your hand? Ah, the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil gave you a protective knot! When you fell into my trap, the knot shattered, breaking you free from my talismans' control!
8252545.ch: 没想到你这么快就醒转了，不可能啊，怎么可能！可恶！你手上那是什么？六目明瞳给你绑了个护身结！你落入我的圈套的同时，护身结碎裂，替你摆脱我符咒的控制！

8252546.en: I'd like to invite you to stay here. Fellow cultivator, from today onward, you may contemplate the path of immortality at my humble estate. Rest assured, I shall host you for as long as you live.
8252546.ch: 我想请你来这小住。道友打今日起，就可在敝庄参悟长生久视之道。你可以放心，只要你活着一天，我便招待你一天。

8252547.en: You are a once-in-an-age master of the world, and I wish for you to be my guest. However, you'll be staying in a dungeon I've specially prepared—a damp, cold place surrounded by venomous creatures and rotting monster organs, where the stench reaches heaven.
8252547.ch: 你是八荒之中不世出的高人，我是希望你留在我家作客。不过你要住在我为你特别打造的地牢之中，那里阴冷潮湿，周围都是毒物，还有各种妖兽的脏器，臭气冲天。

8252548.en: I can see that the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has feelings for you. You're interfering with her—she needs to contemplate the heavenly mysteries. Ever since you appeared, she's changed, become unlike herself. You must be eliminated!
8252548.ch: 我看得出来，六目明瞳应该是喜欢你的。你这是妨碍她，她还要参悟天机。自从你的出现，六目明瞳就发生了改变，她变得不像她自己了。你只能消失！

8252549.en: This isn't jealousy—it's hatred! Ever since I discovered the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil, I've pursued her relentlessly. I meant only well, but she never once acknowledged me! I'm utterly disappointed, utterly disappointed!
8252549.ch: 我不是嫉妒，我是恨！我发现六目明瞳后，一直苦苦追着她，我只是一番好意，但她从来不给予回应！我失望透了，失望透了！

8252550.en: Once you're gone, she'll slowly forget you and return to her former self. I'll bring her here—look, I've built this chamber for her, quite similar to her silken cottage, isn't it? She will stay by my side forever.
8252550.ch: 你不在了，她就会慢慢忘了你，变成以前的她。我要把她请过来，你看这就是我为她打造的房子，跟她的丝萝小筑很像吧？我要她永远陪着我。

8252551.en: Nonsense! She will love me, and we'll spend our lives together here! We'll have many little arachnids, both sons and daughters. The sons will take after me—brilliant and clever, while the daughters will be like her—graceful, noble, and ethereally beautiful.
8252551.ch: 放屁！她会喜欢我的，她会在这里和我厮守一生！以后我会和她生好多好多小蜘蛛，男的女的。男的会像我，以后十分聪明，女的则像她，雍容华贵，美丽脱俗。

8252552.en: I'm not mad—I'm perfectly calm. I'm going to bring her here next. Where to place the talismans, how to lure her in—I've planned everything out meticulously.
8252552.ch: 我没疯，我很冷静，接下来我就要把她请过来。怎么请，应该哪里下符咒，我都想得清清楚楚了。

8252553.en: This is the Xiang family estate. We Xiangs are a mighty clan—our ancestors were once high officials in the Cultivator Alliance. Later, guided by a divine revelation, they endured countless hardships and escaped from Chi You.
8252553.ch: 这是我向家的庄园。我们向家可是很厉害的大族，当年我们祖先可是仙盟之中的要员，后来才凭借一个天机，千辛万苦逃离赤幽州，来到外面。

8252554.en: The Xiang family gathered demons from across the world to create detailed illustrated manuscripts, sharing them with cultivators so they would know every strength and weakness of these monsters. But I think our ancestors' vision was too limited.
8252554.ch: 向家搜罗天下妖类，要将之做成详细的图文秘本，将之公示给修仙者，让修仙者知道妖兽的每一个长处，每一个弱点。不过我觉得祖先们眼界太窄了。

8252555.en: Mere illustrations can never show the complete truth. I will dissect every monster, stitch them back together, and preserve them as specimens. I'll let cultivators see their truest form!
8252555.ch: 做成图录，终究难以叫人看得真切。我要把妖兽全部剖开，再重新缝合，做成塑象，让修士看见它们最真实的一面！

8252556.en: Leave? Now that you're here, you won't be going anywhere.
8252556.ch: 走？既然来了，就别想走了。

8252557.en: S-stop! What... What are you going to do with me?
8252557.ch: 别、别打了！你……你要怎么样？

8252558.en: I won't harass her, I just want to bring her here! She's made her lair in the ley lines! I know she'll wait there for you—she won't move again! I'll bring her here right now...
8252558.ch: 我不会纠缠{name|B}，我只是要把她请过来！她如今在地脉中设了洞府！我知道她会在那等你，她不会再挪窝了！我这就把她弄过来……

8252559.en: What are you... going to do! No! No, please, let me go!
8252559.ch: 你要……干、干嘛！不！不要，放了我！

8252560.en: This matter needed an end, and you have brought it to one.
8252560.ch: 此事终需了结，而你则了结了此事。

8252562.en: The Silken Cottage lies in silence. Its master must be away.
8252562.ch: 丝萝小筑静悄悄的，看来此处主人外出未归。

8252563.en: Two wisps of Qi suddenly dart across the horizon, intertwining with each other. They emit whispered sounds, as if two people are engaged in conversation.
8252563.ch: 只见两团灵气突然窜于天际，彼此交缠，发出呢喃语声，竟似有人互相交谈。

8252564.en: Her probing of the ley lines has even affected the Immortal Shrine. If I weren't so busy with my duties, I'd love to pay this woman a visit. What do you think would happen to her?
8252564.ch: 查探地脉都能影响到仙祠了，如非本仙事务繁多，真想会一会这蜘蛛女。你说她会怎么样？

8252565.en: An arachnid stays alive... until she doesn't.
8252565.ch: 活蜘蛛到死之前都是活的。

8252566.en: Mm, my thoughts exactly. Right now she's only disturbed the ley lines a little, but if she tries anything bigger in the future, she might end up angering the immortals from all the regions.
8252566.ch: 嗯，我也是这么认为的。如今她只是动了一下地脉，日后若有什么大动作，指不定就惹怒分部各州的仙人了。

8252567.en: If the spider has any sense of self-preservation at all, she'd better use it.
8252567.ch: 但凡蜘蛛女有点自知之明，就应该有点自知之明。

8252568.en: True. Actually, I find this woman quite interesting. I just hope she doesn't provoke the three great deities of Chi You.
8252568.ch: 就是，其实我觉得这蜘蛛女还挺有意思的，希望她不要惹到赤幽州那三尊大神。

8252569.en: Just as you try to listen more closely, the two intertwined wisps of Qi in the sky fade away, their voices carried off by the wind.
8252569.ch: 正待细听，两团原本于天上交织的灵气慢慢消失，语声亦随风而去。

8252571.en: This arachnid woman is such a nuisance with all her digging! She's at it every single day! I can't even get a decent sleep without her racket waking me up!
8252571.ch: 这蜘蛛女太能折腾了，天天在那挖地！我睡大觉都能把我折腾起来！

8252572.en: You summoned me just for this? I was in the middle of my medical research.
8252572.ch: 你就为这个赋灵召唤于我？耽误我钻研医道了。

8252573.en: You're no fun at all, young lady! Don't you enjoy a bit of entertainment?
8252573.ch: 你这女娃儿真是不解风情！这热闹也不稀罕啊？

8252574.en: What's there to worry about? The three deities, <r>Battle Soul, Kunwu, and Divine Eye</r>, will surely punish her. Heaven is merciful to all beings... Let's hope a stern warning from the three will suffice.
8252574.ch: 这有什么的？<r>斗魂、昆吾、神目</r>三神定会惩戒这蜘蛛女妖。上天有好生之德，但愿三神小惩大诫即可。

8252575.en: Heh, that arachnid woman doesn't seem to care about anything at all. I bet she'll stir up trouble even when there isn't any, and now she's seriously offended those three who are so quick to resort to violence. Unless some powerful expert like me—a truly well-connected immortal—comes to her rescue, that little spider is definitely... heh, hehehehe!
8252575.ch: 嘿嘿，我看这蜘蛛女是个什么都不在乎的性子，只怕没事还给捅出事来，这下肯定大大的得罪那三个爱动手动脚的。除非有个像本仙菌一样手眼通天的高人搭救，否则啊这小蜘蛛铁定，嘿嘿，嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

8252577.en: A whistling sound pierces the distant sky as shadows of blades and figures dart through the air. Suddenly, a sword blazes with brilliant light, accelerating to overtake a figure's silhouette. In one swift strike, it draws a trail of blood.
8252577.ch: 但听天边啸声响动，剑影人影，穿梭而过。空中长剑突然光芒大盛，加速前突追上人影，一把掠过带出一溜血水。

8252578.en: If you've got the guts, show yourself! What's the point of all these sneaky tricks?
8252578.ch: 有本事就现身相见，装神弄鬼的是要怎样？

8252579.en: After these words, the sword light at the horizon vanishes. {name|B} grits her teeth, wraps spider silk around her wounded arm, and departs.
8252579.ch: 这话说过，天边剑光消亡，{name|B}咬了咬牙，以蛛丝裹住手臂伤口转身去了。

8252580.en: In the distant sky, dark clouds roil and swirl, forming a vortex that resembles a divine eye gazing down upon the earth. Countless bolts of lightning streak down from the center of the whirling clouds, striking the ground below.
8252580.ch: 远空铅云舒卷聚散，形成漩涡，恍似天开一目，俯瞰大地。同时云漩中心射落万道电光，击打地面。

8252581.en: In the distance, you see {name|B} weaving through a lattice of crackling lightning. When unable to dodge in time, she uses strands of silver silk to redirect the strikes elsewhere. The area ahead erupts with continuous explosions, sending fragments of rock and earth flying in all directions.
8252581.ch: 你看向远方却见{name|B}于霹雳电光交织的光栅间传来插去，有时不及躲闪，身受雷击，则射出银丝引导电光落去别处。一时间前方炸响连连，山石土地，被打得碎屑纷飞。

8252582.en: So this is all the mighty Divine Eye is capable of? How disappointing. I have ley lines to investigate—I'll have to decline this little dance.
8252582.ch: 我道神目是有多大本事，也就这样而已？我还要查探八荒地脉，恕不奉陪。

8252583.en: {name|B} gives a slight smile, her form melting into shadow. Like a phantom, she vanishes into the darkness cast by the clouds above, leaving no trace behind.
8252583.ch: {name|B}微微一笑，身化黑影，去如鬼魅，眨眼没入天空云层投下的阴影之中，消失不见。

8252584.en: The air ahead feels strange and charged, as if you're standing in an arena. Blades of wind cut through the air, kicking up clouds of dust. In the distance, {name|B} gracefully weaves between these wind strikes. Wherever these strange winds pass, they carve deep gouges into the earth as if scraped by invisible blades.
8252584.ch: 前方气息有异，站立其中，仿佛身在斗场。其时几道疾风彼此来去，带得周围尘土四起，远方看见{name|B}在几道疾风之间来去闪避，异风过处，地上仿佛遭到硬物刮削，留下硕大凹痕。

8252585.en: Sorry, but I'm not trying to offend your shrines—I simply couldn't care less about your projections. Keep pushing me like this, and one day I might just skip investigating the ley lines and tear down your magnificent shrines instead.
8252585.ch: 抱歉，我无意冒犯斗魂仙祠，因为我根本不将你们这些上界投影放在眼里。再是苦苦相逼，哪天我就不是查探地脉，而是推倒你那壮观宏伟的仙祠了。

8252586.en: Ugh! I'll give it to that white-haired chicken—he's not as weak as he looks. Those fist techniques actually pack quite a punch...
8252586.ch: 呃！白毛鸡倒也不是手无缚鸡之力，这拳风还是有点看头……

8252587.en: A voice echoes from the distance. "Little girl, that insolent tongue of yours earned you a mere slap this time. Mind your manners from now on." The voice resonates with an otherworldly vastness. {name|B} grits her teeth, dodging an incoming gust of wind and seeing it dart away into the distance.
8252587.ch: 此时远方出来语声，“小妞儿出言不逊，所以这次只是掌嘴了，之后可要好自为之了。”声音空洞辽阔，仿佛来自天外。{name|B}咬了咬牙，忙闪身让过一道逼近的疾风顺势投向远方了。

8252588.en: The winds blow gently across Chi You, stirring up withered grass and dust. Through the whistling gusts, voices can be heard carried on the wind.
8252588.ch: 天风徐徐，卷起赤幽州衰草泥尘，但听虎虎风声之中夹杂人语之声。

8252589.en: Keep following me, and I'll burn you to ashes.
8252589.ch: 你再跟着，小心我将你打成一堆炭灰。

8252590.en: You must stop investigating the ley lines. If you continue like this, the projections of the three immortals—Kunwu, Divine Eye, and Battle Soul—will move against you.
8252590.ch: 你不能再查探地脉了，这样下去，昆吾、神目、斗魂三仙投映会出手对付你。

8252591.en: Me? Afraid of those lifeless statues?

8252592.en: For now, stop triggering the Nether Air's rejection! The three will know if you do. Let me talk to them first.
8252592.ch: 这段时间，别再惹起冥气排异反应！三仙会知道的。等我去跟他们说去。

8252593.en: Who do you think you are? Why should I listen to someone without their recognition? Leave Chi You now. Follow me again, and I'll separate your head from your shoulders.
8252593.ch: 你是什么东西？未得其认可，会听你的？从现在起，离开赤幽州，再敢跟着，我叫你身首异处。

8252595.en: The winds subside and voices fade away. All around, only the sound of falling withered grass breaks the silence.
8252595.ch: 此时天风暂歇，人语亦止，周围只有连天的衰草落在地上，发出沙沙的响。

8252596.en: Listen, little girl. I've shown you leniency time and again, yet you keep pushing your luck. Don't you think you're being a bit too disrespectful?
8252596.ch: 小姑娘，我一再容让，你却得寸进尺，这是不是太不给面子了？

8252597.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil, you've used spider threads to connect the underground ley lines, severely agitating the Nether Air's defense mechanism. When the Nether Air strikes back, it will shake the very foundations of the Immortal Shrines.
8252597.ch: 六目明瞳，你借蛛丝连接地底各处地脉，已大大触动冥气的排异意识，到时冥气一举反噬，亦会动摇仙祠根基。

8252598.en: You troublemaker. Since you haven't committed any true evil, I'll let you leave if you stop now.
8252598.ch: 妖孽，念你并未为恶，当下罢手，我放你走路。

8252599.en: Are you here to fight or to chat? For such mighty warriors, you sure love to run your mouths. I'm busy and have no patience for small talk.
8252599.ch: 你们来打架还是来说话的？怎么昂藏男儿，怎么说得比女人还多？我很忙，没耐心跟你们闲话家常。

8252600.en: Ha! I told you reasoning was pointless. Let's just kill this little pest and be done with it.
8252600.ch: 哈哈，我早就说不能讲理的，赶紧将这小虫子打杀了了账。

8252601.en: With a sneer, {name|B} raises her hand, summoning lightning-charged spider threads to strike at Kunwu, Battle Soul, and Divine Eye. The three immortals roar in unison, dispersing the lightning, then launch a fierce combined attack against {name|B}.
8252601.ch: {name|B}一声冷笑，扬手召出天雷蛛丝分击昆吾、斗魂、神目。三仙一声喝斥，化去电光，气势汹汹的合击{name|B}。

8252602.en: Under the combined assault of the three immortals, {name|B} immediately falls into dire straits. It seems she will be reduced to dust in the blink of an eye...
8252602.ch: {name|B}在三仙围攻下，立呈颓势，可以想见她眨眼就会被三仙打成齑粉……

8252603.en: Under the combined assault of the three immortals, {name|B} is clearly at a disadvantage, seemingly on the verge of total defeat.
8252603.ch: {name|B}在三仙围攻下，陷入下风，似乎随时都会被一举击溃。

8252604.en: You have earned recognition, so why do you aid this beast?
8252604.ch: 阁下得了认可，为何协助这灵兽？

8252605.en: Perfect! Our last duel wasn't quite satisfying enough. A group battle should be much more entertaining. What do you say?
8252605.ch: 好啊，原本咱们先前就比过一场，不过打得不过瘾，这次多人混战，更有意思，你们怎么说？

8252606.en: Think you're the only one with the guts to fight, Battle Soul? Kunwu won't be left out of this.
8252606.ch: 就你斗魂有胆一战吗？昆吾当然不落人后。

8252608.en: Interesting. Since you're a cultivator with recognition, I'll let this spider off the hook today—for your sake.
8252608.ch: 有意思，你是得到认可的修士，今日暂且看在你的份上，不与这蜘蛛计较。

8252609.en: Hah! I was only trying to be nice and stop this little pest from getting herself killed, seeing as she's a beast incarnate. But since she's got a protector now, I'll stay out of it. You won't live long anyway.
8252609.ch: 嗐，本看在这小虫子总是灵兽化身，这才好心让她别作死，既然有人保护，那我不插手了，反正你也活不长了。

8252610.en: Young friend, the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is a rare beast indeed. Since you are acquainted with her, please try to talk some sense into her. If you don't, the Nether Air will consume her before we even need to act.
8252610.ch: 小友，六目明瞳总是难得灵兽，你既与她相识，还盼你多加规劝，否则不待我们出手，冥气先就将她吞噬了。

8252611.en: As the three immortals finish speaking, their images fade away one by one, leaving only the wounded {name|B} standing nearby. She watches the energy dissipate in the sky and gives a scornful smile.
8252611.ch: 三仙说完，投影先后散去，仅余受伤的{name|B}呆在不远处。她看了看当空散去的灵力，不屑的笑笑。

8252614.en: {name|B}'s eyes betray a hint of confusion as she speaks these words. Then she turns and walks away.
8252614.ch: {name|B}眼神微乱，说过这话便转身离去了。

8252615.en: You try to help {name|B}, but the supreme coercion emanating from the three immortals forces you back, preventing you from joining the battle.
8252615.ch: 你想协助{name|B}，然而三仙发出的无上威压，将你摒除在外，使你无法参战。

8252616.en: {name|B} glances at you, then struggles to her feet. She walks up to you with a cold stare and suddenly snatches the talisman from your body, giving it a slight smile as she holds it.
8252616.ch: 天香眼光掠过你身上，随即挣扎起来，走到你面前冷冷的看着你，然后伸手一把抓下了你身上的护符，拿在手中微微一笑。

8252617.en: {name|B} speaks as her delicate hands begin to undo the talisman. Her fingers move with supreme grace, dancing like butterflies in flight. The spider silk follows her elegant manipulations, and in the blink of an eye, she's reformed the talisman and presents it to you.
8252617.ch: 天香一边说着素手一边解开那护法。只见手如幻魔，恍似翩翩飞舞的蝴蝶，那蛛丝随她穿插摆弄，眨眼间便重新结好递到你面前。

8252618.en: I'm surprised you still keep this with you. I've come up with a new way to bind talismans recently. Let me remake this one for you.
8252618.ch: 没想到你还带在身上。近日我想到一个新的结符之法，这便给你重新结一下吧。

8252619.en: Mm, staying in this room for a while has helped dissipate all the cold energy from my body. I'm fine now. Let's go.
8252619.ch: 嗯，在这屋中待了一会，我体内的寒气已经泄尽，已经无碍了，这便走吧。

8252620.en: In the darkness, you feel {name|B} approach and briefly search your body. A flash of fire illuminates your vision, revealing a burning talisman between her fingers. In mere moments, the talisman burns away, and darkness engulfs everything once more.
8252620.ch: 黑暗之中，你似乎感觉天香走到你身边在你身上略一摸索，继而眼前火光一亮，之间她手中捻着一张燃着的灵符。但只片刻之间，灵符燃尽，周围又复漆黑。

8252621.en: Hmph. If that sneaky bastard could plant a talisman on you, they must have done the same to me.
8252621.ch: 哼，那鬼鬼祟祟的家伙既能在你身上种下符咒，想必也已在我身上动了手脚。

8252622.en: Another flash of fire appears as {name|B} produces another burning talisman. As it burns away, she gracefully waves her hand, dispersing both the ashes and the murk that clouded your vision. The mountains and valleys around you become clearly visible once more.
8252622.ch: 但瞬间火光又亮，天香又捻出一一张燃着的符咒。那符燃尽后，她素手扬处，飞灰散尽，混沌同时散去，周围山川景致清晰可见。

8252623.en: Oh? How interesting. This is the first time in my life I've received such praise.
8252623.ch: 哦？这话相当有趣。我生平还是第一次听到这样的赞赏呢。

8252624.en: {name|B} gives a slight smile as she pulls out a silver thread. Her delicate hands dance through the air, and in mere moments, she weaves it into a talisman knot and then places it in your hand.
8252624.ch: {name|B}微微一笑，抽出一条银色的丝线，素手上下翻飞，只片刻间便结成一个符结，并交到你手上。

8252625.en: I dislike being in anyone's debt. You gave me a compliment, so I gift you this talisman knot in return. Our business here is done—I'll take my leave.
8252625.ch: 我不习惯欠人东西，你夸我一句，我赠你符结。此间事了，我先走了。

8252626.en: Oh? The little lady knows me quite well.
8252626.ch: 哦？小姑娘还挺了解我的。

8252627.en: {name|B}, usually cold and distant, now shows a hint of a smile. She pulls out a silver thread; her delicate hands dance through the air, and in mere moments, she weaves it into a talisman knot and then places it in your hand.
8252627.ch: {name|B}一向漠然，此时脸上却隐隐透出几分笑意，抽出一条银色的丝线，素手上下翻飞，只片刻间便结成一个符结，并交到你手上。

8252628.en: Just a small token—take it. I have matters to attend to, so I'll be going.
8252628.ch: 小小心意，拿着吧。我还有事，走了。

8252629.en: As {name|B} speaks, she flashes before you, appearing right beside you in the blink of an eye. She gently places her hand on your shoulder.
8252629.ch: {name|B}说着一闪身，已欺到你身边。她手轻轻搭在你肩上。

8252630.en: Little one, are you worried about me? There's really nothing to worry about.
8252630.ch: 小姑娘，你在担心我？其实这没什么可担心的。

8252631.en: I care not what I truly am. The world is ever-changing, and I adapt to its flow, conforming to whatever shape life takes.
8252631.ch: 我并不在乎“我”到底是个什么。世情千变万化，我也能随世俯仰，因圆就方。

8252632.en: What you think of me is what matters—I care nothing for the eyes of others.
8252632.ch: 你认为是怎样，就是怎样，我并不在乎旁人目光。

8252633.en: {name|B} speaks with an icy demeanor. The hand on your shoulder gives a slight lift, and you feel your body becoming weightless as you float through the air—she has already sent you out of the cottage.
8252633.ch: {name|B}冷冰冰的说着，搭在你肩上的手微微一托，你只觉身子轻飘飘的飞掠起来，已被她送出丝萝小筑。

8252634.en: {name|B} turns her gaze toward you, a sharp glint flashing through her cold eyes. Her delicate hands dance through the air, weaving a strand of spider silk into a protective charm in mere moments.
8252634.ch: {name|B}眼光看向你，冷冰冰的眼中精光一闪，她素手翻飞，只片刻间将一条蛛丝编成一个护符。

8252635.en: Seizing the perfect moment, you grip the spider thread and pull with all your might. Your energy flows through it, transforming into an immense force that yanks {name|B} toward you.
8252635.ch: 你乘着当下的良机，手执吐丝使劲一扯，你的灵力传递过去，化成无量巨力，一把将{name|B}扯了过来。

8252636.en: My home isn't a place where people can come and go as they please, you know.
8252636.ch: 我这洞府可不是让人任意来去的噢。

8252637.en: The cosmos is my web, and all creation my prey.
8252637.ch: 以天地为罗网，视万化为猎物。

8252638.en: Within my cottage lies a universe of its own.
8252638.ch: 洞府之中，也是一番天地。

8252639.en: Compared to the universe, we are, in the end, far too small.
8252639.ch: 和宇宙相比，我们终究太过渺小了。

8252640.en: The world is like a reflection in water—shattered at the slightest ripple without a shred of truth to its name.
8252640.ch: 世界就像水里的倒影，一搅就碎，没有半分真实。

8252641.en: These threads know your every thought when they bind your heart, your every step when they bind your feet, and everything you've touched when they bind your hands!
8252641.ch: 这丝儿，缠你的心知道你想什么，缠你的脚知道你去过哪，缠你的手就知道你摸过什么！

8252642.en: My thread shows no mercy—whether it kills or saves depends solely on the heart of its wielder.
8252642.ch: 蛛丝无情，杀人救人，存乎一心。

8252643.en: Immortality, when all is said and done, is nothing but a desperate struggle to exist.
8252643.ch: 长生不灭，说到底不过在挣扎求存。

8252644.en: Are you hurt? Rest here for a while and recover your strength.
8252644.ch: 受伤了？你安心在此静养片刻吧。

8252645.en: People say the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is a noble beast, but what difference is there between beasts and monsters? In the end, they're all just creatures struggling to survive.
8252645.ch: 人说六目明瞳乃是灵兽，可灵兽妖兽，又有什么不同呢？不过都是苦苦挣扎的生灵罢了。

8252646.en: Living and seeing for too long only makes one see through the darkness and filth of this world until their heart grows cold with despair.
8252646.ch: 长生久视，只会让人看透世上的阴暗与污浊，继而心灰意冷。

8260001.en: Hey, I heard the ice witch showed up recently. Really?
8260001.ch: 喂，听说那女冰妖现身八荒了，是也不是呢？

8260002.en: Heh, what do you think I'm here for?
8260002.ch: 嘿嘿，你以为我是来干嘛的？

8260003.en: You? You're planning to capture that witch and take her orb for refinement!
8260003.ch: 你？你是要擒下女冰妖，取她内丹，炼神还虚的！

8260004.en: You really get me, buddy! I've heard that the witch has six eyes, each one a treasure. They say one of those eyeballs is even a divine material for crafting artifacts.
8260004.ch: 知我者，你也！我听闻那女冰妖六个眼睛，个个是宝，其中一个眼珠子还是炼制法宝的神器。

8260005.en: Bro, let's make a deal. I only want her fingernails. I'm planning to create elixirs with their ground powders.
8260005.ch: 哥，我跟你打个商量，我只要她的手甲，我要拿去研磨成粉，制成丹药。

8260006.en: The witch has twelve arms, and you may take as many as you want. However, we must find it first. No time to waste, let's get moving!
8260006.ch: 女冰妖有十二条手臂，随你拿便是。现在关键是，咱们要找着这只女冰妖。别耽误了，咱们快去吧！

8260007.en: The clearing ahead is rimmed with frost. Three or four sect disciples lie motionlessly on the ground, their faces livid. Nearby, a beautiful young woman trembles as she bends to examine them in utter astonishment.
8260007.ch: 只见前方大片地方结着冰霜，地上躺着三四名宗门弟子，脸上呈一股死黑之色。旁边一名俏丽女子颤颤巍巍地俯身查看，脸上尽是难以置信的神色。

8260009.en: They seem to have suffered... severe frostbite from ice spells. Their bodies are completely rigid. I'm afraid they're beyond saving.
8260009.ch: 他们似乎受了……受了寒气冰封，全身僵硬，怕是……没救了。

8260010.en: The woman seems unwilling to say more. She gives you a puzzled once-over as if noticing something extraordinary about you. Then, without another word, she turns away coldly and leaves.
8260010.ch: 眼前女子似乎不想多说，她疑惑地扫视了你一下，似乎觉得你身上有些不可思议之处，然后冷冷的转过头离开了。奇怪的是，女子踏步之际，留下阵阵寒气，结成冰霜，她逐渐远去，同时留下满地冰霜，仿佛一条白色长蛇，蜿蜒远去。

8260014.en: Fine, I'll tell you. I had an arrangement with one of them. He was supposed to give me a secret manual. But when I arrived here, they... they had already met with this terrible fate...
8260014.ch: 罢了，我与这里其中一人有约在先，他要将一本秘籍转赠于我。奈何我赶到此处，他们、他们却已遭了横祸……

8260015.en: Through the hazy veil of wind and snow, you see a solitary house standing in the landscape. Yet there is no one within.
8260015.ch: 风雪迷蒙之中，一个宅子立在雪地之中，然而里面并无人迹。

8260016.en: Her secluded dwelling is utterly silent, with only frigid currents swirling in all directions. Through the doorway, you see her in the inner chamber, seated in cultivation.
8260016.ch: 霜凌的幽居毫无声息，只有阵阵寒流四方周流。透过门户，可见霜凌正在内室之中，坐功修炼。

8260017.en: You follow the woman into the Everfrost, where a dwelling emerges from the snowy expanse, at the location where cold air gathers and disperses. Through a gap in the doorway, you glimpse a woman inside, seated in cultivation. Wisps of ethereal energy flow out and reconvene around her form.
8260017.ch: 你跟随女子来到一个渺无人迹的地方，只见旷野深处露出一处居所。门户空隙处可见里面住着一名女子，其时她正坐功修炼，丝丝氤氲散而复聚，萦绕身周。

8260018.en: Your approach seems to stir her senses. With a quiver in eyelids, her eyes snap open. A wave of biting cold rushes over you with her piercing gaze.
8260018.ch: 你的接近似乎触动了女子的知觉，她眼皮一颤，睁开双目。一股寒意随着她的目光直扑你身。

8260019.en: You... it's you? Didn't you know it's rude to intrude upon my house uninvited?
8260019.ch: 是……你？阁下无故闯入，不觉得太无礼了吗？

8260020.en: Indeed. I am alone here in the Everfrost. Your presence is an intrusion. I must ask you to leave.
8260020.ch: 不错，你已经冒犯到我了，请离开吧。

8260021.en: In this vast snowy wilderness, who could possibly do me harm? You don't need to worry about me.
8260021.ch: 茫茫雪野，哪来对我不利的人？阁下多虑了。

8260023.en: You... your cultivation is impressive. It's the only reason you can barely withstand this place. Others would not be so fortunate.
8260023.ch: 你……修为不差，才能够在此处勉强立足，换作旁人，那可未必。

8260024.en: How do my affairs concern you? Focus on your own matters.
8260024.ch: 我的事与你何干？管好自己吧。

8260026.en: One moment. I have a matter to discuss. Would you be interested in an exchange?
8260026.ch: 喂，阁下既已来到此处，那我想要与你做个交易，不知你意下如何？

8260027.en: This is the manual I seek. If you can obtain it for me, I shall reward you generously. I possess certain treasures; people say they're fragments of otherworldly ice spirits, used to send a cultivator's soul to the primordial domain.
8260027.ch: 这是我在寻找的秘籍，你给我找来，我不会亏待了你。我手中有些秘宝，传为异界冰魄碎屑，能助修士炼神返虚。

8260028.en: Very well, please find it as soon as possible. The fragments melt easily. If you desire the treasure, you must act now.
8260028.ch: 嗯，这便请你去设法找来吧。冰魄容易消解，想要宝物，动作可就要快了。

8260029.en: Hm, I won't force your hand. Remember my words: assist me, and you'll be generously rewarded.
8260029.ch: 呵，那也不强迫你。我话放着，你帮助我，自不会亏待于你。

8260030.en: I have other items to seek as well. Moreover, as you mentioned, there are persons outside plotting against me. While I do not fear them, I'd prefer to avoid direct confrontation.
8260030.ch: 我还要找其他东西。而且，正如你说，外面有人处心积虑，对我不利。我虽不怕他们，却也不愿与他们正面冲突。

8260032.en: Thank you. These are treasures I acquired by luck in the past.
8260032.ch: 多谢，这都是些往日里机缘得到的宝物，

8260033.en: Snow Lady takes the treasure from you. She is examining you intently as if searching for something specific.
8260033.ch: 雪女接过你的宝物之际，仔细地打量着你，似乎正在观察着什么。

8260034.en: She shakes her head, then taps the back of your hand with two fingers. Her touch is oddly cold, unlike that of any ordinary person.
8260034.ch: 霜凌摇了摇头，然后骈指在你手背轻轻一碰，你只觉面前女子手指冰冷异常，浑不像正常之人。

8260035.en: Fellow cultivator, you must be weary from your journey. This is a secret technique to alleviate your fatigue. Oh, and remember, the fragments are not easily obtained, so please use them only when necessary.
8260035.ch: 道友此番劳顿，我有冰心之法可为道友消解疲乏。对了，冰魄得来不易，盼你有需要再使用。

8260036.en: These treasures are hard to come by; once used, they're gone. Use them with caution.
8260036.ch: 宝物得来不易，用一个少一个，谨慎使用吧。

8260037.en: You arrive at her dwelling. She is sitting there for cultivation, Qi swirling around her form. Gusts of frigid wind sweep through the ground, making you extremely uncomfortable.
8260037.ch: 你来到霜凌的住处，其时她正在坐功修炼，身周灵气萦绕。寒风阵阵，让你感觉十分不适。

8260038.en: Sensing your approach, she immediately suppresses her energy. Strangely, as she ends her cultivation, the wind dissipates, and warmth suddenly returns to the surroundings.
8260038.ch: 她察觉有人接近，便即收敛灵力。说也奇怪，她收功以后，寒风消散，周围骤然回暖。

8260039.en: Interrupted during cultivation. Should I consider this a pleasant surprise?
8260039.ch: 修炼之际，有人打扰，我该说好吗？

8260040.en: Hmph. Quiet and peaceful. At least you know how to behave.
8260040.ch: 哼，安安静静的，倒也安分。

8260041.en: As expected. It seems anyone with the ability to speak is incapable of uttering anything worthwhile.
8260041.ch: 果然，但凡是个有嘴巴的，都说不出什么正经言语。

8260042.en: I doubt you're capable of offending me.

8260043.en: ...Indeed. My cultivation technique is rather unique. Compared to ordinary martial arts, it features the biting cold.
8260043.ch: ……不错。我所修炼的颇为特别，较之一般功法，更增几分凛寒。

8260044.en: Enough. What is your purpose here?

8260045.en: Hmph. I fear your offer for the manual is merely a ruse. Your true aim is my collection of treasures.
8260045.ch: 哼，只怕帮我找秘籍是假，垂涎我宝物才是真。

8260046.en: Very well. I do seek a certain manual. You may procure it for me.
8260046.ch: 也罢，我确是有个秘籍想要。你便给我找来吧。

8260047.en: Visit me? I'd rather not see you at all.

8260048.en: Hmph. Since you're here anyway, you might as well find a manual for me. Succeed, and you'll be rewarded fairly.
8260048.ch: 哼，左右你都来到了，帮我找个秘籍吧。得手了不会亏待你。

8260049.en: Isn't it clear that I'm the one being harassed here?
8260049.ch: 我这不是遭到你的骚扰了吗？

8260050.en: You... find a manual for me. Once you obtain it, I'll ensure you're rewarded fairly.
8260050.ch: 你……帮我找本秘籍，到手了，我不会亏待你的。

8260051.en: Then I shall entrust this task to you.

8260053.en: Have you brought what I requested?

8260055.en: By the way, I've heard that an ice witch has been wreaking havoc in the Everfrost recently. Fellow cultivator, did you come here for this creature? They say it is a treasure trove on legs, attracting the covetous eyes of many cultivators.
8260055.ch: 对了，听闻近日附近有冰妖肆虐，道友也是冲着这妖物来的？据说冰妖一身是宝，惹来不少修士觊觎呢。

8260056.en: Indeed, you've already got considerable rewards from me. There's no need for you to risk hunting it.
8260056.ch: 也是，道友从我这也得了不少好处，自不需再冒险找什么冰妖了。

8260057.en: Hmph. These outsider cultivators are nothing but a mob of fools, always spreading baseless rumors. In any case, I've never laid eyes on any so-called ice witch.
8260057.ch: 哼，外界修士，终究一群乌合之众，以讹传讹总是有的。反正我便从未见过什么冰妖。

8260058.en: The cultivators from Yun Mo have turned the Everfrost into quite the spectacle. It would be a feat to remain unaware of the situation.
8260058.ch: 周边修士早把这附近弄得热闹非凡，想要不知，还真不容易。

8260059.en: She stares into your eyes for a moment as if trying to confirm something. Then, she seems to let out a soft sigh before turning back toward her dwelling and bidding you farewell.
8260059.ch: 霜凌盯着你眼睛看了一会，似乎在确认什么。她似乎轻轻吁了口气，然后转身回到屋中，与你别过了。

8260060.en: You return to her dwelling, but today her expression betrays a hint of hesitation; maybe she's contemplating some troubling matter.
8260060.ch: 你再次来到霜凌的住处，不过今日她神色间透出一股迟疑之色，似在考虑什么为难之事。

8260061.en: You've arrived? I was just about to request your assistance.
8260061.ch: 来了？我正想拜托你帮忙。

8260062.en: Very well. I've located the place; you can go there now. The area is rather perilous. Try not to perish.
8260062.ch: 甚好。我已经探明地方，你去就可以了。哼，此地较为危险，不要死掉了。

8260063.en: As she finishes speaking, she furrows her brow, appearing quite hesitant.
8260063.ch: 霜凌说完蹙起了眉头似乎颇为犹豫的样子。

8260065.en: She gives you a concerned look. But then, she seems to steel her resolve with a slight nod.
8260065.ch: 霜凌担忧地打量了你一下，似乎下定了决心似的微一点头。

8260066.en: Hmm, it would be far too perilous for you to venture forth alone. I shall accompany you.
8260066.ch: 嗯，你单独前往未免太过危险，我便与你同去吧。

8260068.en: Danger surely lurks ahead. Are you prepared to proceed?
8260068.ch: 再往前行，必有危险，你准备好了？

8260069.en: You arrive at the location she mentioned, intending to conduct a thorough investigation. To your surprise, you find her already waiting ahead. Hearing your approach, she turns and fixes you with an icy stare.
8260069.ch: 你来到霜凌所说的地方正打算彻查一番，却见霜凌已在前方等候。她听到动静，回过身冷冷的朝你看来。

8260070.en: Investigating this place carries inherent risks. I sent you here, and if you were to perish, the guilt would weigh heavily upon me.
8260070.ch: 探查此地，终究有些风险，我支你来此，万一你死掉了，我可就罪过了。

8260072.en: You defeated the enemies and obtained the manual as instructed, but a sudden chill runs down your spine. Beside you, she casts an icy gaze upon the manual in your hand.
8260072.ch: 你击败敌人后，按照指引取得秘籍后，只觉浑身一寒，旁边霜凌已朝你手中秘籍投来冰冷的目光。

8260073.en: Anxiety etches her features as she scrutinizes you before finally accepting the manual. She glances at you once more, then lets out a sigh.
8260073.ch: 霜凌脸上充斥不安，她打量了你一下后这才接过秘籍。接着她又看了看你，随后舒了口气。

8260074.en: My thanks. Here is the promised reward. Let us part ways here.
8260074.ch: 多谢，这是说好的报酬。喂……我这里有一套能涵养自身灵力，适应冰寒之力的心法，算是回报，也一并教给你吧。嗯……你好好修炼，就此别过。

8260075.en: We'll discuss this matter later. Besides, I can see you're perfectly capable of handling things on your own. You don't need my help at all. Now, hand over the manual.
8260075.ch: 此事以后再说。况且我看你自个也能应付，根本不需我帮助。废话少说，秘籍给我。喂……我这里有一套能涵养自身灵力，适应冰寒之力的心法，算是回报，也一并教给你吧。嗯……你好好修炼，就此别过。

8260076.en: No joking! Give me the manual.
8260076.ch: 无聊！秘籍给我。喂……我这里有一套能涵养自身灵力，适应冰寒之力的心法，算是回报，也一并教给你吧。嗯……你好好修炼，就此别过。

8260077.en: You've arrived? I have another manual to locate. The compensation remains the same.
8260077.ch: 来了？我有秘籍要找，报酬如旧。

8260078.en: Errand-running, you say? Where to begin? You help me find the manual, and I provide compensation. A fair exchange of goods for currency, with no lingering obligations. Nothing more, nothing less.
8260078.ch: 跑腿一说，不知从何说起？你帮我找秘籍，我给你报酬，钱货两清，互不相欠，仅此而已。

8260079.en: Will you assist me or not? I require a definitive answer.

8260080.en: So, for what purpose have you come?

8260081.en: Miss me? You don't understand me at all. Let's not delve into such irrelevancies. You find the manual, I provide compensation. That's all.
8260081.ch: 想我……你根本不了解我。不要扯这些有的没的。你找秘籍，我给报酬。

8260082.en: Now that we've met, will you lend your aid?
8260082.ch: 现如今你见着了，所以要帮我吗？

8260084.en: Might I request your assistance in locating the manual? This shall be your compensation.
8260084.ch: 可以请你帮我找秘籍吗？报酬是这些。

8260085.en: Oh, is that so? How fortuitous our paths have crossed. Since you're here, you may assist me in locating the manual. Rest assured, you shall be duly compensated.
8260085.ch: 噢，既是如此，相请不如偶遇，你帮我找秘籍吧，我会付你报酬的。

8260086.en: Hmm, our destination lies in a realm untouched by mortal footsteps... It should be safe enough. You and I... shall venture forth together.
8260086.ch: 嗯，要去的地方渺无人迹……应该无碍。你我……便同去吧。

8260087.en: I say, your current attire leaves much to be desired.
8260087.ch: 喂，我觉得你这行头差点意思。

8260088.en: Are you mocking my baldness? This is the result of cultivating an exceptionally bold Martial Art.
8260088.ch: 你笑话我秃了？我修炼的功法特别霸道才成这样的。

8260089.en: Well, you've misunderstood my meaning. It's said that the ice witch possesses a magnificent mane of white hair. Imagine how dashing you'd appear with its haircut adorning your head!
8260089.ch: 不不不，你误会我意思了，那冰妖据说有一头很好看的白发，把白发放你头上感觉就帅多了！

8260090.en: T-truly? I would appear more... handsome?

8260091.en: Indeed, who could argue otherwise? Rumor has it that this white hair even has mystical properties including enchanting beauties!
8260091.ch: 谁说不是呢？据说这白发还有异能，可以吸引漂亮女修呢！

8260092.en: I... Oh! I've heard that numerous areas in the Everfrost have inexplicably grown colder of late. This must be done by that witch! Let's seize her now!
8260092.ch: 我……我听说近日多处地方无端变冷，这是那冰妖频繁外出活动的痕迹！咱们去拿了她！

8260093.en: Precisely. If we succeed, you shall have the witch's white hair, and I'll claim the rest. How does that sound?
8260093.ch: 正是这个道理，到时冰妖的白发给你，其他给我怎么样……

8260094.en: As they continue their conversation, the two figures gradually walk into the distance. Soon, they vanish from sight in the blink of an eye.
8260094.ch: 二人说话间渐行渐远，转眼便不见了。

8260095.en: Upon arriving at the agreed place, you're greeted by a chilling sight. Fallen cultivators strewed the ground, their bodies turned an appalling livid. Frost clings to their skin, suggesting they've succumbed to severe freezing injuries.
8260095.ch: 你来到与霜凌约定的地点，只见地上横七竖八躺着若干修士，他们身体发青，皮肤上结有冰霜，似乎是遭冻伤倒地。

8260096.en: The woman stands not far away, her face drained of color as she stares in panic at the scene. Meanwhile, waves of frigid air surge through the vicinity; it is an unnatural chill permeating the atmosphere.
8260096.ch: 而霜凌站在不远处，脸色苍白惊慌失措的看着面前一切，于此同时阵阵寒流在附近涌动。

8260098.en: I... I don't know. When I arrived, they had already collapsed on the ground.
8260098.ch: 我……不知道，来到的时候他们已经倒在地上了。

8260099.en: The manual... I've found the manual. We should depart immediately.
8260099.ch: 秘籍……秘籍我已经找到了，咱们这就离开吧。

8260100.en: With trembling steps, she retreats and leans against a nearby tree. Her eyes dart about restlessly, betraying a disturbed mind racing with thoughts.
8260100.ch: 霜凌颤颤巍巍的走开两步靠在一棵树上，眼珠子不断转动，似乎正在思索着什么。

8260101.en: Nothing... The tough journey has merely taken its toll. I simply need a moment to catch my breath.
8260101.ch: 没……长途跋涉有些累了，我喘口气就好。

8260102.en: And no need to guess what happened. Cease your baseless speculations.
8260102.ch: 没有的事，你不要胡乱揣测。

8260103.en: Why do you linger? Here's your compensation. Take it and be on your way. I shall depart after a brief respite.
8260103.ch: 你留在这里干什么？这是报酬，拿过就走吧。我歇息一下就走。

8260104.en: ...There's nothing to worry about. If you won't leave, then I shall. Oh, and in the coming days, I... I'll have a secluded cultivation. Don't come unless it's absolutely necessary...
8260104.ch: ……没什么可担心的，你不走，我走了。对了近日，我……我要闭关静修，没什么事不要来了……

8260105.en: With a final, disoriented glance at the surroundings, she summons her artifact and departs in a blur of motion.
8260105.ch: {name|B}失魂落魄又看了看周围，然后施法召出法器，迅速离去了。

8260106.en: The scene is a tableau of chaos, with cultivators lying on the ground haphazardly. The tree she leaned against moments ago is now encased in frost that in the blink of an eye congeals into a layer of ice. The verdant tree a few moments before is now nothing more than an ice sculpture...
8260106.ch: 现场横七竖八躺着修士，那棵{name|B}靠过的树木，无端结霜，眨眼间凝作一层玄冰。原本生机盎然的树木，只一瞬间便成了个冰雕……

8260107.en: Oh, and in the coming days, I... I'll have a secluded cultivation. Don't come unless it's absolutely necessary...
8260107.ch: 对了近日，我……我要闭关静修，没什么事不要来了……

8260110.en: She sits in cultivation, waves of energy surging around as frigid bursts erupt from her form. Suddenly, sensing an approaching presence, she ends her cultivation and opens her eyes to meet your gaze.
8260110.ch: 霜凌正坐功修炼，身周气流激荡，阵阵寒气汹涌而出。她似乎察觉到有人接近，便立即收功，睁眼向你看来。

8260112.en: Didn't I tell you to stay away? Your presence is not required at this time. Do not linger without purpose. Leave now.
8260112.ch: 不是让你别来吗？近日不需要，没事不要逗留，快走吧。

8260113.en: Hmm, it is of some use. It's hardly anything remarkable. I have a few more here. Take them and be on your way.
8260113.ch: 嗯，此物不过略有用处，终究也不是什么了不起的东西，我这还有一些，你拿着然后走吧。

8260114.en: ...Now that you've seen me, you may take your leave.

8260116.en: Why do you still linger here? There is no further need for your presence. What purpose does your prolonged stay serve?
8260116.ch: 你怎么还在此处，如今没有用得着你的地方，赖在这里作甚？

8260117.en: Who said we were friends? Didn't I make it clear? You help me find the manual, and I provide compensation. That's all.
8260117.ch: 谁跟你是朋友了？不是说了吗？你帮我找秘籍，我给你报酬，仅此而已。

8260118.en: Depart at once. I have no time to entertain your presence.
8260118.ch: 快快离开，我没空招呼你。

8260119.en: She then ignores you and turns back, immersing herself in the pages of a book.
8260119.ch: 霜凌根本不想理会你，只背过了身子，自去翻看书籍。

8260120.en: Even if I had troubles, I don't need a stranger like you to meddle in my affairs.
8260120.ch: 就算有心事，又轮到你这个陌生人来说三道四了？

8260121.en: I don't think you could solve my troubles if I had any. Or are you simply a busybody who delights in prying into others' lives?
8260121.ch: 就算有心事，你又能帮我解决了？还是说你是个闲人，就爱围着旁人转？

8260124.en: Don't you understand that I am politely requesting your departure?
8260124.ch: 难道你看不出我在下逐客令？

8260126.en: Bro, my imagination fails me. A witch with four heads, eight legs, and twelve arms? What a grotesque form does it take?
8260126.ch: 兄弟，那冰妖近日有外出活动的迹象，她定在这附近。

8260127.en: Eh? That differs from what I've heard. They say that it takes the form of a quite captivating beauty!
8260127.ch: 噤声！我们这样大声说话，也许就让那女妖知道了。

8260128.en: Shall we venture forth and uncover the truth ourselves?
8260128.ch: 这附近寒风虎虎的，任她有天视地听之能也别想察觉到我们。

8260129.en: Maybe not! This demon is said to devour vital essences. Say, four heads mean eight nostrils, and how much essence do you have for it?
8260129.ch: 还是小心一些好，别要到时正面冲突，吃亏的总是我们。

8260130.en: So you wish to flee? I, on the other hand, am eager to slay it. Bringing its head back to the sect would surely elevate my standing.
8260130.ch: 快走吧，别让旁人捷足先登了。

8260131.en: Good bro, heed my counsel. Let us only tarry here a while. It would be folly to risk our lives for no certain gain.
8260131.ch: 兄弟啊，你听我的，咱们就在这里待一待得了，没得好处没捞着，自己丢了性命。

8260132.en: Ah, the mere thought fills me with elation! Picture this: the witch's leg slung over my shoulder, its eyeball clutched in my hand. My person adorned with such trophies—how magnificent I would appear!
8260132.ch: 唉，想想就觉得美，我这边扛着冰妖的腿，手里把捏着她的眼珠子，一身战利品，挂在身上多神气！

8260133.en: Cease your idle fantasies! I'd rather refine the trophies into a powerful artifact.
8260133.ch: 你想想得了！我还想把那妖物的东西拿来炼了做成法宝呢。

8260134.en: Indeed. Let us first focus on surviving.
8260134.ch: 是，咱们还是先保住性命吧。

8260135.en: You approach the pair, and they become alert; their gazes snapping toward you.
8260135.ch: 你接近二人，他们同时生出警觉向你看来。

8260136.en: Curse our luck! We are overheard! Teach this person a lesson!
8260136.ch: 完了，我们说的他都听到了！哪来的家伙，教训他！

8260137.en: Dear fellow cultivator, let us reason together! There's no need for conflict!
8260137.ch: 道友有话好说，有话好说！

8260138.en: We know! You surely are seeking information about that demoness! We'll divulge all we know!
8260138.ch: 道友无非想知道那妖女的事！我们都说！

8260139.en: Fellow cultivator, the woman appears to be a stunning beauty with frost-white hair, but in truth, she is a terrifying demon.
8260139.ch: 道友，那女子眼看是个白毛美女，但其实是个可怕的妖怪。

8260140.en: Indeed, we witnessed it with our own eyes. Once, we tracked her to a town in Yun Mo. Everywhere she passed, flora withered and perished.
8260140.ch: 不错，这都是我们亲眼看见的。有一回我们跟踪那个女子到云陌州的城镇之中，她所到之处花木尽数凋萎。

8260141.en: That's but a trifle. I beheld her touch someone, and the person froze to death in an instant! It's a truly horrifying sight. Could she be draining the life essence from her victims?
8260141.ch: 这还没什么，我看见她与人接触，那人一下子就被冻死了，非常骇人，怕不是吸干了旁人的阳气吧？

8260142.en: You may not be aware, esteemed one, but a mysterious figure has placed a bounty on this woman, seeking her capture. This enigmatic person likely wishes to rid the world of a great menace.
8260142.ch: 您有所不知，有神秘人悬赏这名女子，希望我们能够将之制住。这位神秘人大概是希望为八荒除一大害吧。

8260143.en: That may not be the case. This demoness has a unique constitution. Maybe this figure intends to use her as a cultivation vessel and absorb her frost essence for advancement.
8260143.ch: 那又不见得就是这样。这妖女体质特异，指不定这神秘人要了她做炉鼎吸了她的寒气修炼也未可知。

8260144.en: Indeed, indeed, your words ring true! Well... Our dearest, most venerable master, might we take our leave now?
8260144.ch: 是极是极，你说得对！那个……大能，我们可以走了吗？

8260145.en: We have divulged all we know. Might you now let us go?
8260145.ch: 我们知道的都已经说了，这便放了咱们吧？

8260146.en: Our deepest gratitude, mighty master! A thousand thanks!

8260147.en: The pair scramble to their feet with the words and flee in a most undignified manner.
8260147.ch: 二人一边说，一边爬了起来，狼狈地逃了。

8260148.en: Aargh! I have revealed all you sought to know! Why? By the heavens, why?!
8260148.ch: 啊！你要知道的我都已经说了，为什么？为什么！

8260149.en: Amidst painful cries, the two cultivators crumple to the ground...
8260149.ch: 惨呼声中，二人倒在了地上……

8260150.ch: 听说一同来到这边抓拿雪妖的修士有人着了毒手了。

8260151.en: How could this happen? They hadn't even been touched by the witch.

8260152.en: True, their bodies bear no marks, but the witch's frigid energy seeped into them and drained their vitality.
8260152.ch: 寒冰蚕食人体生机，慢慢就灵力衰竭而死，模样儿可难看了。

8260153.en: So... they simply withered away into death?
8260153.ch: 冰妖手段竟这般恶毒？我们要快快找到这女妖将她诛了。

8260154.ch: 说是这么说，但没准照面了，我们也落个身死道消的下场。

8260155.en: The witch's tactics grow ever more vile! We must track down this fiend at all costs!
8260155.ch: 斩妖除魔是我辈义所当为，怎能胆怯懦弱？

8260156.en: Indeed. I shall summon the fiercest flames to reduce her to ashes, inch by inch...
8260156.ch: 你说得是……不能落下了，我们先走吧。

8260157.en: No... No! I fear the witch's curse has already taken hold of me. I am doomed!
8260157.ch: 我不要……我不要，我总觉得我已经着了那冰妖的暗伤。我要死了！

8260158.en: Cease this needless self-torment. Come, let us avenge our fallen peers.
8260158.ch: 不要自己吓自己，走吧，去替他们报仇。

8260160.en: Three figures are talking ahead. Approaching will draw their attention...
8260160.ch: 前方三人正在谈话，若在接近将引其注意……

8260161.en: Hmph. What business do you have inquiring about her?
8260161.ch: 哼，阁下为何想知道她的事？

8260162.en: Fellow cultivator, that woman is shrouded in an aura of bitter cold that no mortal can endure.
8260162.ch: 道友，那女子周身散发寒气，一般人无法抵受。

8260163.en: In combat, she drains the vitality from her foes, leaving them frozen solid. Truly, she is a formidable adversary.
8260163.ch: 若是交手她更会吸取旁人阳气，将对手冻住，是个极可怕的对手。

8260164.en: No, no, I've seen her! I swear I have! She walked through a verdant forest lush with flora, and in her wake, everything withered and froze...
8260164.ch: 不，不，我见过，其实我见过，她走在一片林子里，那儿原本好花好木，但她一经过就全凋谢了，全结冰了……

8260165.en: Fellow cultivator, please help me dissuade my companions from this hunt! Otherwise... otherwise we'll all end up as frost-bitten husks!
8260165.ch: 道友，你劝劝我的两位朋友，让他们打消追杀此女的念头吧！不然、不然我们也会落得个变成冰冻干尸的下场！

8260166.en: Look at you, cowering like a frightened child... If you fear death so much, begone from our sight this instant!
8260166.ch: 看你这怂样儿……怕死别参和，赶紧滚吧！

8260167.en: We accepted a bounty to slay this demonic woman, yet upon encountering her, she captured our dear companions.
8260167.ch: 我们得了悬赏要击杀这妖女，可是中途遭遇此人反而被她拿住我们的挚友。

8260168.en: That accursed fiend! The moment she grasped them, she drained their vitality, leaving them as frozen statues...
8260168.ch: 这可恶的妖魔，只一抓住他们就把他们的阳气吸光了，把他们冻成冰块……

8260169.en: We were on the verge of retreat after a long, fruitless fight. But now, with our brethren slain, this vendetta has become an unbreakable blood oath.
8260169.ch: 原本久战无功，我们都要退走了，但这下两位兄弟被杀，仇恨却是万万无法解开了。

8260170.en: Now, we shall capture this witch, even if we cannot get any compensation!
8260170.ch: 如今就不为悬赏的奖励也要抓住此女！

8260171.en: Indeed! I shall subject her to unimaginable torment until her last breath!
8260171.ch: 不错，我要将她千刀万剐，折磨致死！

8260172.en: Ridiculous! You're in league with that witch, aren't you?
8260172.ch: 岂有此理，你和那妖女是一党的对吧？

8260173.en: If you're an accomplice, you shall share her fate!
8260173.ch: 既是那妖魔的党羽，就一并杀了！

8260174.en: You may have bested us, but other cultivators in this icy realm still seek her demise... You cannot stop them all...
8260174.ch: 你打倒了我们，可这冰源之中还有其他修士要拿他呢……你阻止不了……

8260175.en: Sooner or later, she'll drain your vitality, leaving you as a frozen husk too...
8260175.ch: 你迟早要被她吸干阳气，变成冰块儿……

8260176.en: Their voices grow fainter with each passing breath. At last, they slump to the ground, falling into an eternal silence...
8260176.ch: 二人说话声越来越低，最后他们躺下了，再无丝毫动静……

8260177.en: With no words left to spare for them, you turn and depart from the grim scene.
8260177.ch: 你无心跟他们说话，转身离开了。

8260178.en: I propose we set a trap for the white-haired demon.
8260178.ch: 兄弟，其实我总觉得那雪妖也不是故意的，也许她需要旁人帮助……

8260179.en: What strategy do you have in mind?
8260179.ch: 放屁，你这样子，不用打了，雪妖一定会杀死你的。

8260180.en: Though the witch rarely emerges from her lair, I've observed her occasionally sneaking out in search of manuals.
8260180.ch: 不是，我总觉得所谓她身上的寒气更像是不得已带着的，她更像是在躲着旁人。

8260181.en: Do you suggest we acquire some rare manuals to lure her into our trap?

8260182.ch: 她觉得自己怀着寒气，会祸害旁人，于是在无人荒野安身落脚，免得在人迹之处害了别人。

8260183.ch: 你这话对我说也就罢了，咱们结盟来抓雪妖，被旁人听见，可不会轻易饶你。我们不能落下了，快走吧。

8260184.en: Furthermore, from my observations, the demon's frost aura grows more potent as her powers increase. Time is not on our side—we must act swiftly.
8260184.ch: 而且依我所见，这妖女的寒气似乎随着她的实力提升越来越厉害，留给我们的时间，不多了。

8260185.en: Indeed. If left unchecked, she will ultimately bring calamity upon all living beings. Our actions, though harsh, serve to protect the world.
8260185.ch: 嗯，任其成长，最终还是会危害八荒生灵。我们做的一切都是为了八荒。

8260186.en: Two figures whisper in hushed tones ahead. If you get closer, you'll surely draw their attention...
8260186.ch: 前方二人正在密谋什么，一再接近必将引起他们注意……

8260187.en: Heh. A cultivator seeking someone here. Do you think we believe you're unaware of the witch?
8260187.ch: 来到此处寻人的修士，还有不知道那妖女的？

8260188.en: Hmph! That fiend emanates an otherworldly frost. All who dare approach fall victim to her touch. At best, the chill seeps into the bones and saps their vitality, and at worst, it hurts one's veins and drains their essence until naught remains but a statue of ice.
8260188.ch: 哼，那女妖怪身怀奇特寒气，任谁接近都会被其波及，轻则寒气袭体，气机转弱，重则伤及命脉，阳气丧失，被冻成玄冰。

8260189.en: To be frank, we suspect her power grows ever stronger. It seems she's using cultivation techniques to amplify the icy energy within her.
8260189.ch: 坦白说，据我等推测，那妖修的寒气越来越厉害了。她似乎通过修炼增强体内寒气。

8260190.en: In essence, every increment of her power amplifies her frost aura accordingly. As her strength grows, so too does the radius of her chilling influence.
8260190.ch: 换言之，若她修为强得一分，这寒气就会厉害一分，旁人也越容易受到的影响。

8260191.en: Should the demoness achieve a breakthrough one day, I fear her icy scourge may engulf all of Yun Mo.
8260191.ch: 假如有朝一日这女妖修境界有所突破，只怕危害就会波及云陌州。

8260192.en: We've observed her venturing out in search of manuals to hone her abilities. She sequesters herself within the depths of Everfrost, eluding our most exhaustive efforts to locate her. Left with no alternative, we've resorted to gathering manuals she might covet, hoping to draw her out and end this threat once and for all.
8260192.ch: 我们也发现她会经常外出寻找秘籍以不断修炼增强自己的实力。女妖修于冰原闭关，我们费了九牛二虎之力都找不到她的所在，不得已，只好收集一些她可能想要的秘籍，将她诱出击杀。

8260193.en: Fellow cultivator, if we allow this demoness to amass more power, she'll soon become unstoppable. Will you join our cause? Together, we can vanquish this fiend and safeguard the realms. Isn't this a worthy endeavor for one who walks the path of cultivation?
8260193.ch: 朋友，任女妖修坐大，日后就难以制止了，要不要加入我们，一起除了这魔鬼，为八荒做点事？

8260194.en: What is the meaning of this unprovoked aggression, good cultivator?
8260194.ch: 阁下无故出手，是何道理？

8260195.en: Outrageous! This one must be in league with the fiend. Cut down this accomplice first, then we'll deal with the witch herself!
8260195.ch: 岂有此理，这人和那女妖修是一道的。先将她的羽翼斩了再说！

8260196.en: Very well. We know this task is not one to be undertaken lightly. If you are unwilling to join our cause, we shall not press further, good cultivator.
8260196.ch: 也罢，此事原是强人所难。阁下不愿，我们也不好相逼。

8260197.en: Her eyes, weary and vacant, stare into the distance as she sits alone outside her dwelling. Occasionally, she raises her head; her icy visage betrays an endless sorrow.
8260197.ch: 霜凌双眼疲惫无神，独坐屋外，偶一抬头，冷冰冰的面容上显出无尽愁烦。

8260198.en: Why have you returned? I have no need for manuals at present. Leave me be.
8260198.ch: 为什么又来了？暂时不需要找秘籍了。你走吧。

8260199.en: The affairs of others are neither my concern nor worth my attention.
8260199.ch: 旁人要做什么，我管不着，也犯不着去管。

8260200.en: Why did you mention that witch? Nonsense! I haven't the faintest idea what you're talking about!
8260200.ch: 什么……冰妖不冰妖的！不知道你说什么！

8260201.en: Isn't it the very essence of a cultivator's career to seek enlightenment through ancient texts? Or perhaps you'd have me believe your mastery of the arts sprouted from thin air?
8260201.ch: 修士求仙问道，寻找秘籍，岂非再正常不过？敢情你一身术法都是无师自通的。

8260202.en: You're grasping at straws. Let's get to the point, okay?
8260202.ch: 东拉西扯的，我不知道你想说什么？

8260203.en: Be it cold or warm. Everfrost is frigid enough without your frosty jests. Are you here merely to spout such chilling absurdities?
8260203.ch: 什么寒气热气，我这边本就够冷的了，你还来讲冷笑话吗？

8260204.en: Heh. My secrets are irrelevant to you. And, if I really have a closely guarded secret, why would I tell you?
8260204.ch: 可笑，先不说我有是没有。既是难言之隐，凭什么要跟你说？

8260205.en: Good. Please do me a favor by vanishing from my sight this instant.
8260205.ch: 那好，帮帮我。请你赶紧消失。

8260206.en: You dare to trespass upon my threshold without invitation, and yet you have the gall to demand explanations from me? What an absurdity!
8260206.ch: 你来到我家门口，得到我允许了不？竟还要我给个说法，真是笑话。

8260207.en: Persist in your meddling if you must, but I have no time to indulge in your frivolous prattle.
8260207.ch: 你爱纠缠那也由得你，我可没功夫与你瞎扯。

8260210.en: You must leave at once. How dare you breach the sanctity of a lady's abode? Dear esteemed cultivator, your conduct is utterly reprehensible.
8260210.ch: 你、你该走了，闯入女子家中成何体统？阁下行为着实叫人齿冷。

8260211.en: With a mere flick of her wrist, the courtyard gates slam shut and keep you out. She casts one final, frigid glance before turning back toward her dwelling; her silence is more resolute than any words.
8260211.ch: 霜凌信手一挥，屋前院落门扉关闭，将你隔绝开去。只见她冷冷的看你一眼，慢慢转回屋子，更无别话。

8260212.en: As you approach her dwelling, you find the gate firmly shut. Yet, flickering lights dance within, betraying the presence of its mistress inside.
8260212.ch: 你来到霜凌住处，只见大门紧闭，内屋却闪烁灯光，可见主人就在里面。

8260213.en: You shout out to greet her, but the light abruptly extinguishes. An eerie silence envelops the surroundings, broken only by the haunting whistle of Everfrost's relentless winds.
8260213.ch: 你发声招呼后，内屋灯光随即熄灭，周围静无人声，唯有天风呼呼吹拂。

8260214.en: Meanwhile, a bone-chilling cold converges around you, its icy tendrils invading your body. An unsettling sensation courses through your veins as if winter itself has taken root within you.
8260214.ch: 与此同时，你感觉四周阴寒聚拢入侵，一股难受的感觉周流体内。

8260215.en: As you approach her dwelling, you find the gate firmly shut. However, the flickering lights betray the presence of its mistress inside.
8260215.ch: 你来到霜凌住处，只见大门紧闭，内屋亮着灯火，想必主人就在里面。

8260216.en: You shout out to greet her, but the light abruptly extinguishes. This swift action speaks volumes: you are unwelcome.
8260216.ch: 你发声招呼后，内屋灯光随即熄灭，可知主人态度坚定，正拒绝你的造访。

8260217.en: Meanwhile, a bone-chilling cold converges around you, its icy tendrils invading your body. An unsettling sensation courses through your veins as if winter itself has taken root within you. Should this frigid assault persist, your condition may be impacted.
8260217.ch: 与此同时，你感觉四周阴寒聚拢入侵，一股难受的感觉周流体内。若持续受到寒气侵袭，恐怕会有不利。

8260218.en: As you approach her dwelling, you find the gate firmly shut. However, the occasional sounds in it betray the presence of its mistress inside.
8260218.ch: 你来到霜凌住处，只见大门紧闭，屋中偶尔却发出些许声响，想必主人必在里面。

8260219.en: As your greeting rings out, a sudden sound of something shattering echoes from within. Moments later, the door flies open and she emerges, her eyes glistening with barely contained tears.
8260219.ch: 你发声招呼后，内屋发出物件掉落的碎裂之声，随即屋门洞开，霜凌眼中泪光滢滢，走了出来。

8260220.en: Why do you persist in coming here? Why do you risk your own life?
8260220.ch: 一直往这里跑！不要命了吗！

8260221.en: I am a harbinger of calamity... All who cross my path are fated to suffer misfortune.
8260221.ch: 我是一个灾星……见着我的都只有倒霉的份儿。

8260223.en: Is unraveling the truth... so crucial? I'm not worthy of such efforts...
8260223.ch: 弄明白一切……真的有那么重要吗？我不值得……

8260225.en: She gazes at you, her eyes brimming with sorrow and resignation; then she gives you a slight nod. Without a word, she leads you to a secluded grove where flowers and trees bloom in abundance.
8260225.ch: 霜凌带着满是哀伤与无奈的眼看了看你，然后点了点头。然后把你带到一处花树繁茂之地。

8260226.en: As she strolls, nature withers in her wake: flowers wilt, trees wither, and once-fertile soil cracks beneath her feet. She pauses, a resigned smile playing on her lips. In an instant, frost erupts around her, enveloping everything here, from plants and trees to soil and stones, in sheets of ice.
8260226.ch: 她信步行走，所到之处，花木凋萎，沃土干裂。她无奈一笑，停下脚步。周围冰霜疯长，任是花草树木，还是土地岩石，只眨眼间便结成片片玄冰。

8260227.en: Do you see? An icy energy resides within me, its influence reaching far and wide. All that draw near—be they people, beasts, or objects—fall prey to my freezing aura. The ignorant, in their limited understanding, label me the so-called ice witch. And I am the one the cultivators of Yun Mo seek in the Everfrost...
8260227.ch: 看见了吗？我体内蕴有冰寒，能够波及四方。无论人畜事物，一旦接近，都会被我寒气冰封。无知者一知半解，便以为我是冰妖。附近修士找的，正是我……

8260228.en: But where else can I go if not here? As you've witnessed, any place teeming with life withers instantly at my touch.
8260228.ch: 可是不留此处，我又能去哪？正如你所见，一切生机盎然之处，都能被我转瞬毁去。

8260229.en: Once, I dreamed of visiting a bustling town in Yun Mo. But in the blink of an eye, my presence transformed there into a frozen wasteland. Countless lives were wiped out because of me...
8260229.ch: 曾经有过一次，我做梦梦到来到云陌州中繁华之地，但整个城市眨眼就被我变成一个冰窟，无数生命因我而消亡逝去……

8260230.en: I was utterly terrified... I reasoned that only by remaining in the desolate Everfrost could I stop harming the innocent and taking other lives. Isn't that so?
8260230.ch: 我害怕极了……我想，唯有留在这个荒芜无人之地，才能避免伤及无辜，破坏生灵吧？

8260231.en: Given my unique constitution, I've always strived to remain inconspicuous. Yet, at some point, cultivators seemed to become aware of my existence. They now scour Everfrost relentlessly, seeking any trace of my presence.
8260231.ch: 鉴于体质特异，我一向低调行事，却不知从何时起，似乎有修士察觉我的存在，他们不断在附近搜索我的行踪。

8260232.en: My dwelling is well-concealed, but at times, I'm compelled to venture out in search of manuals. During these journeys. I may encounter the cultivators. The energy within me is overwhelmingly potent, and should they let their guard down for even a moment, they would...
8260232.ch: 我的住处极为隐秘，但有时不得已外出寻找秘籍，一来二去，便遇上这些修士。体内寒气极为霸道，他们一个不慎便……便……

8260233.en: Because of this, they've branded me a demonic cultivator, a monster. They scour every corner, driven by a thirst for vengeance...
8260233.ch: 他们因此将我当成是邪修魔鬼，四处搜索，只想拿住好报复仇恨……

8260234.en: If you really resisted the frigid energy, you wouldn't be suffering its effects now...
8260234.ch: 如果你真的抵挡住了寒气，近日便不会遭受寒气侵袭了……

8260235.en: When we first met, I observed that you could indeed withstand my aura. That's why I was willing to seek your aid and meet with you...
8260235.ch: 最开始你我相遇，我也发现你确实能够抵挡我的寒气侵袭。所以我才愿意请你帮忙，与你见面……

8260236.en: But... but lately, I've noticed the cold's influence taking hold of you. Your complexion grows worse by the day... just like those I've... frozen to death...
8260236.ch: 可是……可是……近日我发现你也已经受到寒气的影响，脸色变得越来越难看……就像那些被我冻死的人一样……

8260237.en: The energy within me seems innate and impossible to dispel. Yet, in this world, there are indeed some who rewrote their destiny. So, I placed my hope in cultivation, seeking to eradicate this freezing cold from me.
8260237.ch: 我体内寒气与生俱来，无法驱散。但八荒之中却有不少大能逆天改命，我便寄望于修炼，借此根除体内寒气。

8260238.en: To cultivate, one must seek manuals. I've searched tirelessly, uncovering numerous methods to dispel this body-chilling cold. However, these techniques are fragmented, and scattered across various manuals. I could only track down each and every one.
8260238.ch: 既要修炼，自当寻找秘籍，我苦心寻觅，找到不少驱散体寒的法子，但这些法子散佚不全，记录在各种秘籍之中，不得已，我只能设法将之找来。

8260239.en: At first, it proved effective since there were several instances where I completely suppressed the cold. But as I continued to cultivate and my power grew, the freezing energy within me became increasingly volatile.
8260239.ch: 开始之时确实有用，有好几次我都完全将寒气压制住了。但随着我修为不断提升，那寒气也变得越发活跃。

8260240.en: I had hoped to subdue the cold through cultivation, but as my power grew, so too did the energy, and it eventually became uncontrollable. At times, I'm tempted to give up entirely... I'm so weary, so very weary...
8260240.ch: 我有时候真想就此算了……真的好累……好累……

8260241.en: All these years... I've tried everything, absolutely everything! There's no hope left...
8260241.ch: 这么多年过去，我什么都试过了，什么都试过了！没有办法了……

8260242.en: These manuals I've found... Aren't they the distilled wisdom of countless predecessors? If they couldn't solve my problem, what difference could one more person like you possibly make?
8260242.ch: 我找到的这些秘籍，本就是前人千锤百炼的心得？他们都无法解决我的问题，只多你一个又有何用？

8260243.en: You! Why can't you understand? Right now you're merely affected by the cold, but ultimately it will claim your life!
8260243.ch: 你！怎么就不明白呢？现如今只是受到寒气的影响，可最后你会死的！

8260244.en: She grits her teeth, her face as cold as frost. Bewildered and enraged by your actions, she whirls around with a dramatic sweep of her sleeve and storms off.
8260244.ch: 霜凌贝齿咬紧，脸若寒霜，她似乎对你的行为十分不解，也十分生气，当下袖子一甩，就此离去。

8260245.en: I was born to bring misfortune to others. You should leave; you should get as far away from me as possible...
8260245.ch: 我天生就会为旁人带来不幸，你应该离开，离得远远的……

8260246.en: You return to her dwelling, only to find it empty save for a layer of frost. The mistress of this abode has long since vanished.
8260246.ch: 你再次来到霜凌的住处，然则屋中除去冰霜，已然空空如也。此间主人早已不知所踪。

8260247.en: As you approach her dwelling, you find her sitting motionlessly in the courtyard, lost in thought. Shock flashes across her face as she sees you, but her expression soon settles back into its usual icy composure.
8260247.ch: 你来到霜凌的住处，只见她呆坐屋外院子，正低头寻思，她看见你来瞬间变得震惊异常，但神情随即宁定，恢复那冷冰冰的模样。

8260248.en: What brings you here? Didn't you comprehend my words?
8260248.ch: 来这干嘛？是没听明白我的话吗？

8260249.en: This is my burden alone. It concerns no one else, nor do I require anyone to share in it.
8260249.ch: 这是我自己的事，与旁人无关，更不需旁人去分担。

8260250.en: Should you return here again, I fear it will be you who needs saving.
8260250.ch: 你再来我这里，只怕就到你要去求救了。

8260251.en: Upon hearing these words, a profound sorrow wells up in her eyes. Tears cascade down her face, pattering softly on the ground and converging into small, glistening pools...
8260251.ch: {name|B}闻言，眼中透出悲伤，清泪汹涌而出，滴答滴答落在地上，濡成小滩水迹……

8260252.en: She bursts into uncontrollable sobs, yet she is nodding in affirmation. Gradually, a glimmer of life returns to her dull eyes.
8260252.ch: 霜凌忍不住痛哭起来，但她一边哭却一边点着头，原本黯淡无光的眼睛之中渐渐透出神采。

8260253.en: I know, I know! I will keep seeking methods to subdue this energy within me.
8260253.ch: 我知道的，我知道的！我一定会继续努力找法子压制体内的寒气的。

8260254.en: She is momentarily taken aback by these words. But soon, she swiftly regains her composure, her face settling into a mask of dignity. Her tears have ceased to flow.
8260254.ch: 霜凌听了这话，先是一愕，但旋又立即端起脸来。然而眼泪却是止住了。

8260255.en: Are you teasing me with such roundabout words? I... I understand your meaning. Rest assured, I won't give up.
8260255.ch: 绕着弯儿取笑人么？我……明白你的意思。我，不会自暴自弃的。

8260256.en: These words seem to ignite something within her. A spark illuminates her beautiful eyes...
8260256.ch: 霜凌听了这话，仿佛受到了什么激发，美丽的眼中透出光芒……

8260257.ch: 我心里一直都明白得很……

8260258.en: If you're merely passing through, then be on your way at once.
8260258.ch: 既是路过，那就赶紧走开。

8260261.en: You... Hey, you're the one on the verge of tears, not I!

8260262.en: It seems all men under the heavens are born with a silver tongue...
8260262.ch: 天下男子，果然都有油嘴滑舌的本性……

8260263.en: ...(A faint, almost imperceptible smile flickers across her face. If the dynamic expression is hard to be seen, consider combining it with SFX.)

8260264.en: Naturally, I shall continue my quest to eradicate the energy within me. I've neglected this pursuit as of late, so I must set out to seek manuals once more.
8260264.ch: 当然是继续寻找根除我体内寒气的法子。近日落下了此事，我还得费些时候重新寻找有用的秘籍，这之后我会去到云陌州，你可以到那边找我。

8260265.en: ...Perhaps you could assist me in locating manuals later. The compensation remains unchanged. Well... I mean if you have the time to spare.
8260265.ch: ……稍后来帮我找秘籍吧，报酬如旧。嗯……我的意思是，如果你有空的话。

8260267.en: ...Don't get so overconfident. In all seriousness, I've located several valuable manuals, but I need assistance in procuring them. Rest assured, you'll be well compensated for your efforts. What say you?
8260267.ch: ……别臭美了。说认真的，我找到不少有用的秘籍，但需要人帮我设法寻来，报酬不会少你的，如何？

8260269.en: I've continued my search for manuals as of late and have discovered several that may prove useful. These manuals are quite precious and, as such, are not easily obtained.
8260269.ch: 我近日继续找秘籍，发现不少可能有用的。这些秘籍颇为珍贵，因此也不易寻得。

8260270.en: As I mentioned before, should you choose to assist me, the compensation remains unchanged. What say you?
8260270.ch: 正如我说的，如果你能帮忙，报酬如旧，如何？

8260271.en: Indeed, I do require your assistance. After all, were I to venture into bustling mortal realms, I fear I would encounter difficulties.
8260271.ch: 嗯，确实需要你帮助。毕竟若是我进入人迹繁华之地，恐怕多有不便。

8260272.en: Should you lend your aid, the compensation remains as before. Do you agree?
8260272.ch: 你帮忙的话，报酬如旧，如何？

8260273.en: My thanks. Ah, this item possesses a remarkable ability. Perhaps it will offer you an additional measure of safety during your travels.
8260273.ch: 多谢。对了，此物颇有妙用，你在外冒险，带着也许能多加几分安全。

8260274.en: As she speaks, she removes an earring and holds it out before you.
8260274.ch: 霜凌说着从耳朵上摘下坠子，将之递到你面前。

8260275.en: This earring is inlaid with blazing jade, capable of warding off frigid energies. A valuable treasure.
8260275.ch: 这耳坠上镶有烈炎真玉，可辟寒气。是不错的宝物。

8260276.en: ...This way, I... no, my energy will not easily affect you...
8260276.ch: ……这样一来，我，不，寒气就不易对你造成影响了……

8260277.en: This item can no longer suppress the icy energy within me. However, the cold must pass through barriers before reaching you, and therefore this earring can still provide some measure of relief.
8260277.ch: 此物已经无法压制我体内寒气。但寒气从我身体散发再传到你身上，终究隔了一重，这坠子还是能缓和一下的。

8260278.en: Very well. Shall we set out to find those manuals?

8260279.en: If you don't take it, how... how am I supposed to accompany you in search of the manuals?
8260279.ch: 你不拿着，我……我怎么好跟你一起去寻找秘籍呢？

8260280.en: She casts a cold glance at you, then presses the earring into your hand.
8260280.ch: 霜凌冷冷的看了你一眼，将坠子强行塞到你手上。

8260281.en: Let us depart at once. There's no time to waste.
8260281.ch: 我们赶紧出发吧，不要耽搁了。

8260282.en: Ahead lies the repository of the manuals. Are you ready? There may be evil spirits or fierce demons within, so please retreat at once after you obtain the manual. I shall await your return here.
8260282.ch: 前方即是收藏秘籍之所在，准备好再进入吧？指不定里面有什么恶煞凶妖之类的。拿到就赶紧出来吧，我在此等你。

8260283.en: If I accompanied you inside and my icy energy became uncontrollable, I would only hinder you... Perhaps I should remain outside.
8260283.ch: 我也进去的话，假若寒气突然不受控制，反而会影响你……还是不一同进入了吧。

8260284.en: Nonsense... I shall enter with you. Should any mishap occur, I will withdraw immediately.
8260284.ch: 胡说八道……我与你一同进入，若有意外，我便先退出来吧。

8260285.en: Indeed, there shouldn't be any complications. Nevertheless, I... I shall accompany you inside.
8260285.ch: 嗯，应该是没啥意外的。不过，我、我还是跟你一起进去吧。

8260286.en: Exercise utmost caution. I... I shall accompany you inside.
8260286.ch: 万事小心。我、我还是跟你一起进去吧。

8260287.en: We've obtained what we need. Let us depart.

8260288.en: Look at you, so full of yourself.

8260290.en: Since I served as your combat support, might we consider a reduction in your compensation?
8260290.ch: 我当打手，那报酬是否可以酌量减少？

8260292.en: Hey... Thank you. For helping me find the manual, and for allowing me to accompany you.
8260292.ch: 喂，多谢你……帮我找秘籍，也多谢你让我跟你一起行动。

8260293.en: Having spoken, she presses the compensation into your hand before abruptly turning and departing.
8260293.ch: 霜凌说完急忙将报酬交到你手，然后转头离开。

8260294.en: At last, you've arrived. This time, your assistance becomes indispensable.
8260294.ch: 你可来了，这回真要你帮忙了。

8260295.en: A valuable artifact is to be auctioned at an upcoming event. Should I enter such a bustling locale, I fear others may not withstand my frigid aura. Thus, I require you to act on my behalf and secure this treasure.
8260295.ch: 有个宝物将于拍卖会中进行拍卖。我一旦进入繁华之地，不见得旁人能够抵御我的寒气，这要你出面帮我将宝物拿下。

8260296.en: I shall inform you of the time and location of the auction. When the moment arrives, I will remain beyond the city gates. Once you've acquired the item, simply deliver it to me.
8260296.ch: 拍卖会将于何时何地举行，到时我留城外，你拿到再转交给我即可。

8260298.en: Thanks. The item is now in my possession.

8260299.en: At this moment, a child gazes at her with curiosity, clutching a handkerchief and approaching her step by step.
8260299.ch: 此时一名小孩好奇的看着霜凌，手中拿着一块帕巾一步一步的朝她走了过去。

8260300.en: Halt! Child, what do you think you're doing?
8260300.ch: 那小孩儿……干嘛朝我过来？你、你帮我让他停下，别靠近我！

8260301.en: The child approaches and offers the handkerchief. She pauses in hesitation but ultimately accepts it. She then gently pats the child's head, who smiles before departing.
8260301.ch: 小孩走上前去，将帕子递给霜凌，脸露犹豫，最终还是将帕子接过，然后摸了摸孩子的头，小孩儿这才笑着离开了。

8260303.en: The child remained unharmed only because you secretly placed the earring on your target.
8260303.ch: 孩子安然无恙不过是因为你将坠子挂到他身上罢了，

8260304.en: I know I'm not a monster...

8260305.en: Isn't my past confidence the bane of others? Alas...
8260305.ch: 从前不正是自信才致旁人丧命吗？唉……

8260307.en: She casts a cold glance at you, then raises her fair hand and pats your head. At that moment, the jade earring you placed on the child is transferred to you.
8260307.ch: 霜凌冷冷的看了你一眼，然后起玉手轻舒，伸了过来摸了摸你的头，那枚你暗中挂在小孩儿身上的烈玉坠子已一并挂到你身上了。

8260308.en: The child has no need for such an item. Do not part with the earring merely to appease me; it took great effort to obtain. Our business here is concluded. Let us depart.
8260308.ch: 此物小孩儿用不着，别为了哄我就丢了坠子，那可是我花了很多心思才找着的。此间事毕，走了。

8260309.en: No sooner has she departed than an arachnid descends from above, landing in your palm. The creature catches fire for no reason and turns to ash in an instant. Only a slip of paper remains; it bears four words, "She still harbors secrets."
8260309.ch: 霜凌才离开，一只蜘蛛从空中落下，掉在你手掌之中。那蜘蛛自燃起来，瞬间化为飞灰，最后留下一张纸条，上书“她还有秘密”五字。

8260310.en: As the child attempts to approach, a flicker of fear crosses her usually frigid countenance. Instinctively, she turns away and departs in haste.
8260310.ch: 小孩儿还要上前，霜凌冷冰冰的脸上显出一丝惧意，她下意识地转过身子，急步离开了。

8260311.en: What took you so long to catch up?

8260312.en: ...At least I'm not hiding from you, am I?

8260313.en: The child is unaware of the demon within me. To him, I am merely a beautiful lady.
8260313.ch: 小孩儿又不知道我体内有可怕的魔鬼，他只知道面前是个美丽的大姐姐。

8260314.en: I'm not jesting. I only speak objectively, stating nothing but the truth.
8260314.ch: 没开玩笑，我这是以事论事，实话实说罢了。

8260315.en: What are you implying? That I'm not gentle now? I've never been harsh with you.
8260315.ch: 这是何意？现如今我就不温柔了？我可没凶过你。

8260317.en: The manual is in our possession. Let us depart at once.
